Metadata.title: Pageist: Your Reading Habit
Metadata.description: Track your reading habits, book progress, and personal growth with Pageist app. Your private companion for building a consistent reading habit.
Metadata.openGraphDescription: Your personal companion for tracking reading habits, book progress, and personal growth. Private, secure, and designed to help you build a consistent reading habit.

01.title: Add Books You’re Reading
01.description: Search for any book or add it manually to start tracking your reading journey effortlessly.

02.title: Log Your Current Page Daily
02.description: Quickly log your current page each day. The app counts read pages and keeps you on track with your goals.

03.title: Visualize Progress with Heatmap
03.description: See your reading streaks and daily progress at a glance with an intuitive yearly heatmap.

04.title: Book Details & Personal Insights
04.description: Tap any book to see detailed progress, historical logs, and insights tailored to that specific book.

05.title: Discover Advanced Stats & Insights
05.description: Analyze your reading habits, track pages/day, streaks, and monthly progress to understand your performance.
